faqs.question: Which is better, 99acres or MagicBricks?
faqs.answer: On features they are very similar: both offer free basic owner listings, paid packages for brokers and builders, project pages and lead management. Which works better depends on your city, locality and price band, so test the smallest package on one for a month and compare cost per site visit.

faqs.question: Who owns 99acres and MagicBricks?
faqs.answer: 99acres is owned by Info Edge, the company behind Naukri.com, and was launched in 2005. MagicBricks is part of the Times Group (Times Internet) and was launched in 2006.

faqs.question: Does 99acres charge money?
faqs.answer: Buyers and tenants use it free, and owners can post a basic listing free with limits. Brokers, dealers and builders pay for packages that include more listings and better placement. Prices vary by city and package and are often negotiable.

faqs.question: Is MagicBricks free for owners?
faqs.answer: Yes, owners can post a basic listing free. Paid plans add visibility and extra services. Free listings usually appear below featured and premium ones in busy localities.

faqs.question: Are 99acres and MagicBricks reliable?
faqs.answer: Both are long-established platforms. Buyers should still check RERA registration, avoid paying a token before a site visit and watch for stale or duplicate listings. Sellers should expect a mix of serious buyers and early browsers, and reply fast because buyers enquire on many listings.

faqs.question: Why do portal leads not convert?
faqs.answer: The same buyer usually enquires on several similar listings, so many advertisers call them. Brokers who reply within minutes on WhatsApp, ask two qualifying questions and offer two site-visit slots convert far more than those who call the next day.

faqs.question: What are the top property websites in India?
faqs.answer: The main ones are 99acres, MagicBricks, Housing.com, NoBroker and Square Yards. NoBroker focuses on owner-to-buyer and owner-to-tenant deals without brokers.

faqs.question: Should a builder use portals or their own ads?
faqs.answer: Most builders use both: a portal project page for presence and credibility, and most of the budget on their own landing page, Meta and Google ads and an instant WhatsApp reply, because those leads come to the builder alone.
